description: RESCHEDULES an existing appointment to a new time (and optionally a new calendar). This MODIFIES the calendar and, unless suppressed, may send update emails. Acuity REST: PUT /appointments/{id}/reschedule.

admin.description: If true, reschedule as admin (bypasses availability checks).

calendarID.description: Move the appointment to this calendar id.

datetime.description: New start time in ISO 8601 with offset, e.g. '2026-08-16T10:00:00-0400' (required).

name: acuity_reschedule_appointment
title: Reschedule appointment
